generator.build_command: Merged tzcode2026d.tar.gz and tzdata2026d.tar.gz into one directory, then ran `make zic` with Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2, Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0).
generator.command: ./zic -b slim -d <OUT> africa antarctica asia australasia etcetera europe northamerica southamerica factory backward
generator.slim_vs_fat: Slim (-b slim) TZif files: explicit transitions end at the last rule change describable without repetition; later instants are resolved from the POSIX-footer rule per RFC 8536 section 3.3. The selected parser evaluates the footer dynamically (see crate rustdoc).
